status: partial evidence; purchase comparison, not reliability ranking

scope.older: Original U.S.-market 2006–2009 Saab 9-5 B235 four-cylinder, FWD, factory FA57 automatic; sedan comparison. Equipment and VIN restrictions remain necessary.
scope.newer: Original U.S.-market 2011 second-generation 9-5 Turbo4/Turbo4 Premium sedan, A20NFT/LHU, FWD, AF40 automatic.
scope.excluded: Manual, diesel, BioPower-specific, V6, AWD/XWD; no generic donor interchange approval.

comparisons.older: B235 port injection; injectors discharge before intake valves.
comparisons.newer: LHU direct injection adds a mechanical high-pressure pump and high-pressure rail. Rail service requires a new high-pressure pipe.
comparisons.practical_implication: The B235 avoids this particular high-pressure pump/pipe repair dependency. Diagnose both tank supply and high-pressure side on the LHU.
comparisons.classification: source-supported comparison; ownership implication is engineering inference
comparisons.remaining_unknown: Matched injector and pump repair quotes; comparative frequency unknown.

comparisons.older: 2006/2007 four-cylinder WIS removes the accessory Poly-V belt from the pump. Access still involves intake, steering-pump and pipe work.
comparisons.newer: LHU pump is driven by the balance-shaft chain. EN-44602 holds the sprocket during pump replacement.
comparisons.practical_implication: The LHU adds chain-retention tooling and risk from incorrect sprocket handling. Neither job should be priced as a bare pump alone.
comparisons.classification: source-supported comparison; ownership implication is engineering inference
comparisons.remaining_unknown: 2008/2009 pump procedure not separately verified here; matched labor and complete materials unknown.

comparisons.older: The LHU intake-valve advisory does not establish the same defect in B235. A cold-running B235 still needs diagnosis on its own evidence.
comparisons.newer: Saab Parts advisory explicitly includes 2011 A20NFT: hard cold start, stall/misfire and low compression, improving hot.
comparisons.practical_implication: Require a genuine cold start; a warmed-up demonstration cannot resolve the LHU concern. Cold compression/leakdown can expose work beyond an external-assembly restoration.
comparisons.classification: source-supported comparison; ownership implication is engineering inference
comparisons.remaining_unknown: Frequency, comparative incidence and proven revised-valve durability remain unknown.

comparisons.older: The cited B205/B235 sludge bulletin concerns 1998–2003; do not assign that bulletin automatically to 2006–2009. Later PCV/oil-trap hardware requires its own inspection.
comparisons.newer: LHU has factory mechanical oil-pressure diagnosis; oil condition and turbo oil supply matter.
comparisons.practical_implication: Investigate history, pressure and actual contamination on both. Early B235 sludge reputation alone is not evidence against a late car.
comparisons.classification: source-supported comparison; ownership implication is engineering inference
comparisons.remaining_unknown: No comparable sludge/oil-pressure failure rates; unknown histories stay unresolved.

comparisons.older: B235 timing/balance-drive concerns need correct year-specific inspection; early sludge-related instructions are not universal late-car thresholds.
comparisons.newer: LHU primary timing kit is separate from balance chain, tensioner and associated service materials.
comparisons.practical_implication: Neither a chain-kit listing nor lack of noise establishes healthy drives. Price the diagnosed scope, tools and hardware.
comparisons.classification: source-supported comparison; ownership implication is engineering inference
comparisons.remaining_unknown: Matched late-B235 chain parts and labor coverage; no universal preventive replacement interval established.

comparisons.older: T7 uses a black ignition-discharge cassette; red T5 cassette is not an approved substitute.
comparisons.newer: LHU uses four separate ignition coils.
comparisons.practical_implication: Compare one cassette with the relevant number of individual coils, and diagnose plugs, wiring and power supply before buying assemblies.
comparisons.classification: source-supported comparison; ownership implication is engineering inference
comparisons.remaining_unknown: Comparative service life and current original-installed supplier/revisions unknown.

comparisons.older: FA57 five-speed: retain correct 3309 fluid and year-specific level procedure; 2008 no-dipstick service is documented. Early 2002–2004 bulletin is not proof of a 2006–2009 defect.
comparisons.newer: AF40-family six-speed: AW1 service and temperature-based level procedure; controller replacement includes programming and learning. GM 6T40/6T45 control parts are not a substitute.
comparisons.practical_implication: Both require cold/hot operation, engagement, scan and fluid-condition evidence. A nonrunner leaves a potentially expensive transmission unresolved.
comparisons.classification: source-supported comparison; ownership implication is engineering inference
comparisons.remaining_unknown: No validated comparison of failure rates, rebuild prices or donor assembly equivalence.

comparisons.older: TWICE/T7 security matching and Tech 2 procedures can make a missing-key/module fault specialist work.
comparisons.newer: Module-specific SPS/setup, security and network dependencies also require planned access to suitable tools.
comparisons.practical_implication: Prove working keys and module communication before assuming a no-start needs an engine part. Check local programming access before purchasing either.
comparisons.classification: source-supported comparison; ownership implication is engineering inference
comparisons.remaining_unknown: Present-day subscriptions, used-module eligibility and local costs are unverified.

comparisons.older: 2007 WIS documents cable-operated shoes and adjustment.
comparisons.newer: 2011 catalogue identifies an electronic parking-brake controller and configuration-dependent cables.
comparisons.practical_implication: The newer system adds controller/electrical diagnosis; the older system still needs cable, shoe and corrosion inspection.
comparisons.classification: source-supported comparison; ownership implication is engineering inference
comparisons.remaining_unknown: Matched actuator/cable availability and repair quotes; verify each candidate equipment.

comparisons.older: A Nissens automatic radiator seller SKU 32019620 is advertised for 2002–2009; manufacturer interchange and candidate VIN still need checking.
comparisons.newer: Target automatic radiator 13241729 was advertised unavailable at the observed retailer.
comparisons.practical_implication: An unavailable major assembly can delay an otherwise straightforward repair. Check alternate suppliers and used condition before treating a listing as a restoration blocker.
comparisons.classification: source-supported comparison; ownership implication is engineering inference
comparisons.remaining_unknown: This is one aftermarket-versus-OEM example, not equal-quality pricing or proof all older parts are easier to obtain.

comparisons.older: Body/subframe mounting corrosion can turn a replaceable suspension component into structural work. Sedan/wagon body differences must remain separate.
comparisons.newer: FWD subframe service exists, while Saab-specific lamps/body equipment need exact-market availability checks.
comparisons.practical_implication: Inspect load-bearing structure, mounting points, brake lines and accident repairs on both. Condition can outweigh the service-design differences.
comparisons.classification: source-supported comparison; ownership implication is engineering inference
comparisons.remaining_unknown: No matched structural repair quotes or complete body-parts supply survey.

comparisons.older: Actual part, revision and interface evidence is required for a donor or replacement.
comparisons.newer: GM architecture/shared service numbers do not approve an entire donor assembly, ECU, ABS or transmission.
comparisons.practical_implication: Evaluate each replacement independently; category C supplier fitment and category D candidates remain below identical-OE or approved-supersession evidence.
comparisons.classification: source-supported comparison; ownership implication is engineering inference
comparisons.remaining_unknown: No new category A/B cross-brand approvals arise from this comparison.

limits: No measured comparative failure frequency, expected lifespan, reliability score or model-year winner has been established.

Observed prices are parts-only advertised USD offers, not delivered stock or installed repair quotes. Tax, shipping, cores, seals, fluids, tools, programming and labor remain unpriced unless separately documented.
A simpler service design can reduce the work in a particular repair; it does not establish a lower fleet failure rate.
Evidence for one WIS year or equipment version is not blanket verification of every 2006–2009 build. Confirm VIN, engine, gearbox and options.
Historical WIS programming procedures do not verify present-day tool subscriptions or local specialist access.
critical_gaps: Matched VIN-specific parts inventories and official supersessions for both generations.
Comparable U.S. labor quotes for cold-valve/head work, timing drives, transmission faults and security-module replacement.
Matched body, lighting, HVAC and electronic-module availability including used and remanufactured options.
Current security/programming service availability and cost for a real candidate.
Year-by-year 2006–2009 equipment, safety-campaign applicability and VIN-level recall completion.
True cold compression/leakdown, mechanical oil pressure, all-module scans, structural inspection and transmission testing on actual candidates.
cost_comparison_notes: One black cassette: $316.10; one LHU coil: $56.59; four coils arithmetic subtotal: $226.36. These are different replacement units, not equivalent diagnosed repair baskets. No recommendation to replace four coils for a single-coil fault.
Older Nissens radiator $211.98 advertised in stock versus newer Saab radiator $613.70 advertised unavailable. Different brands and supply states; neither is an installed quote.

LHU Bosch 66814 pump alternative $288.29 at RM European is supported aftermarket interchange (C), not proof of an identical original pump or a durability upgrade. B235 avoids this particular direct-injection high-pressure pump; it still has a tank fuel pump.

purchase_protocol.STOP: Confirmed major engine/transmission rebuild need outside the stated objective; unsafe structural damage; unresolved critical safety defect that cannot be responsibly repaired within scope.
purchase_protocol.HOLD: No true cold test, missing keys, missing module communication, unverified gearbox operation, unknown structural condition, or missing rare part without a credible supply path.
purchase_protocol.FINALIST: Configuration and ownership verified, structure inspected, cold engine and transmission evidence obtained, security functional, and a written repair/parts/programming budget is feasible. This is not a safety or purchase approval.
